correctness.rationale: Every automorphism is a permutation by the coordinate-support argument. The transposition centralizer count follows from direct normal form of a rank-one square-zero linear map. Every other permutation is bounded using its orbits on ordered matrix positions, and distinct swap intersections are controlled by their product; the numerical n>=32 bound follows from explicit geometric estimates. Exact independent exhaustive n=2,3,4 and transposition-fixed n=5 computations agree with the formulas. The full-dimensional result relies on symbolic proof, not enumeration.
